name: web-trgovina
description: Web trgovina odjeće — Express + MongoDB API i React klijent

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
